_meta.note: Hand-written matchup tips based on champion abilities. Add more champions here in the same shape.

strengths: Wins extended trades once bleed stacks
E pull catches people trying to escape
weaknesses: Easy to kite
Weak to ranged poke
Few dashes, so he struggles to reach backline
playing_against: Avoid long fights. His bleed stacks to 5 and he gets much stronger
Stand inside or far outside his Q, not at the blade's edge
Trade when his E is on cooldown
Anti-heal reduces his Q heal

strengths: Q silences and speeds him up
weaknesses: No hard crowd control besides Q's silence
Poke stops his passive regen
Easy to kite after Q is used
playing_against: Poke him regularly so his passive regen doesn't kick in
Respect Q. Back off when he speeds towards you
Don't fight inside his E spin when you're low
Trade once Q is on cooldown

strengths: Two-part E dash for engage and escape
weaknesses: Falls off later in the game
Weak with no fury
Mostly relies on winning lane early
playing_against: Play safe early and survive until he falls off
Avoid trading when his fury is high
Punish him after his E is used
Anti-heal hurts his Q sustain

strengths: Q resets on marked or killed targets, giving lots of mobility
Very strong with full passive stacks
weaknesses: Weak when her passive isn't stacked
Hard crowd control interrupts her
Struggles if she can't reach low-health minions
playing_against: Fight when her passive stacks have run out
Don't let her chain Qs through low-health minions to reach you
Save crowd control for after she dashes in
Step out of her E line

strengths: Vitals deal true damage and heal her
W parries damage, and stuns if it parries hard crowd control
R Grand Challenge heals her whole team
weaknesses: Relies on her W timing
Short range
Weaker in team fights before key items
playing_against: Bait out her W before using hard crowd control
Keep trades short and move so she can't hit vitals easily
Anti-heal reduces her sustain
Don't split-push against her alone late in the game

strengths: E root, and his passive pulls rooted enemies
R drains health and heals him
weaknesses: Low mobility
Long cooldowns if his E misses
Can be burst down before R gets going
playing_against: Dodge his E. It's the start of most of his combos
Don't stay close to him while his R is active
Anti-heal reduces his R drain
Burst him before he ramps up

strengths: Q hits harder on a single (isolated) target

weaknesses: Low mobility
Easy to kite
Weak to magic resist
playing_against: Don't stand alone in his Q area
Back away when his passive activates
Magic resist and Mercury's Treads help
Anti-heal reduces his W heal

strengths: Q has three casts, each with a high-damage sweet spot
Strong healing, boosted further by R
weaknesses: Relies on landing Q sweet spots
Weak while Q is on cooldown
Anti-heal cuts much of his sustain
playing_against: Move out of the Q sweet spot. Step towards him or away from the edge
Trade while his Q is on cooldown
